svg.title: Topkapı Gecesi · palace night stealth
svg.desc: Banner for Topkapı Gecesi: a moonlit Ottoman palace with the Tower of Justice, domes and kitchen chimneys; a guard with a halberd sweeps his vision cone across the courtyard past a lantern while a page crouches in the cypress shadow with the diamond; Claude Game Arena, built by Claude Opus 5.5.
